gapReason.reason: The port carries forty-three of the row's fifty-one defs. The eight it does not carry are the parts of Ruby's cache the port does not have: `codename_card?` (cache/all.rb:41-43), `populate_ids` (cache/populate.rb:5-7) and `seed_from_stash` (cache/populate.rb:49) are the CACHE POPULATION half - Ruby pre-fills the cache from the deck's own rows at boot - and the port's cache is filled on demand, so the port has nothing to populate. `reset` (cache/class_methods.rb:47-50 and cache/shared_class.rb:22-25), `shared_cache` (class_methods.rb:107-110) and `stamp` (shared_class.rb:5-7) are the class-level cache REGISTRY and the shared-cache STAMP, and the port's cache is an instance the caller holds rather than a class-level registry. The row's own blocker named the view-cache cluster and the populate cluster as named skips, and the port's fetch module (src/card/fetch.ts:16 and :32) names lib/card/cache/all.rb for the expiry half it does carry.
